title: Lena and the Silence
author: Wren Nystrom
blurb: Beatrix Ashgrove, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
